attachment_requirements_sha256.description: Optional sha256 of the envelope attachment-requirements registry bytes (artifacts/registries/envelope-attachment-requirements.csv) used by the verifier for required-attachment checks.

envelope_kinds_sha256.description: Optional sha256 of the envelope-kind registry bytes (artifacts/registries/envelope-kinds.csv) used by the verifier for kind->schema validation.

manifest_jcs_sha256.description: Optional sha256 of manifest.json RFC8785-JCS canonical bytes (formatting-independent boundary identifier). Present only when the manifest parses as JSON.

manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of manifest.json raw bytes (bundle boundary identifier).

packet_dir.description: Packet identifier for the report. Publishable reports SHOULD avoid absolute paths; prefer a basename or deployment-level packet ID.

policy_profile_sha256.description: Optional sha256 pin of the verifier policy profile used to interpret trust roots, thresholds, and time rules. For JSON profiles, compute over RFC8785-JCS canonical bytes (docs/176). Intended to be published alongside the report (see schemas/VerifierPolicyProfile.json).

problems.description: List of publishable verifier problem codes. Implementations MAY append non-sensitive context after ':' for local debugging; public reports SHOULD be able to publish codes only.

receipt_profiles_sha256.description: Optional sha256 of the receipt profile registry bytes (artifacts/registries/receipt-profiles.csv) used by the verifier to interpret transparency receipt profile identifiers.

verifier_problem_codes_sha256.description: Optional sha256 of the publishable problem-code registry bytes (artifacts/registries/verifier-problem-codes.csv) used to interpret problems[] for comparability.

verifier_profiles_sha256.description: Optional sha256 of the verifier profile registry bytes (artifacts/registries/verifier-profiles.csv) used to interpret supported profile claims for comparability.

verifier_report_tbs_digest.description: Optional pointer to an implementation-scoped verifier report EvidenceEnvelope tbs_digest (kind: hfv.verifier.report) so packet results can be compared across verifier identities.
